biography.value: Ashwalkers stride into the middle of things and let their Heat Aura do supplementary work while their strikes deliver the primary punishment. They do not retreat. They have no concept of tactical withdrawal — they are fire, and fire does not back away from something that is not water. A Summoner who places one between allies and enemies and steps back will find it performs the job adequately until something wetter than expected shows up.

system.creatureSubtype: Large size, Powerful Build; immune to fire damage; does not need air, food, drink, or sleep
system.tactics: Ashwalkers stride into melee and let their aura do supplementary work while their fists deliver the primary punishment. They enjoy fighting and will pursue routed enemies without prompting, which is either useful or a problem depending on the circumstance.
system.attacksNotes:
Burning Fist [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 7 + Melee Combat 4), Reach: 10 ft

  • Margin 1:: 9 damage (5 + 4 Str) + 3 fire damage (Half DR)
  • Margin 2: 9 damage, DR halved (round up) + 3 fire damage; target gains Singed condition
  • Margin 3: 9 damage, DR halved (round up) + 3 fire damage; target gains Ignited condition
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Immolation Aura: Creatures that start their turn within 5 feet of the Ashwalker take 3 fire damage (Half DR). Fire Immunity. Powerful Build: Counts as Huge for carrying, pushing, dragging, and lifting.
